scenario.summary: UAT-6275 (also known as TAG-193) targets government entities in the CIS region using diverse infection vectors including macro-enabled documents, PowerShell downloaders, and a WinRAR path traversal exploit (CVE-2025-8088). The campaign deploys custom reverse shells such as PickleShell, Chvost, and Laplas, securing long-term access through Scheduled Tasks and Windows Startup folder persistence.

meta.rationale: Focus scoping on workstation systems where users frequently handle archive files or documents. Prioritize sectors mentioned in the report like government, resource management, and energy.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has established a foothold using WinRAR path traversal or macro-enabled documents to execute GitHub-hosted PowerShell scripts and persist via custom reverse shells.

hunt.name: UAT-6275 Endpoint Infection and Persistence Lifecycle
hunt.description: This hunt examines the workstation infection lifecycle of the UAT-6275 (Silent Lynx) cluster. It begins by identifying hosts vulnerable to the WinRAR CVE-2025-8088 exploit, then searches for evidence of PowerShell payload retrieval from GitHub. The second phase pivots to look for persistence mechanisms—specifically scheduled tasks referencing custom malware families—and corroborates this with rare outbound network connections indicative of reverse shell C2.

config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE instr(',' || '{{target_cves}}' || ',', ',' || cve_uid || ',') > 0
config.description: Identify hosts with the CVE-2025-8088 vulnerability to focus the hunt on potential targets for the Chain D infection.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, script_content, time FROM hb_script_activity WHERE (LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%github.com%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%raw.githubusercontent%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify PowerShell script execution that references GitHub hosting, matching the Chain C delivery method.
config.expected_signal: Script blocks that attempt to download or execute code directly from GitHub. Silence indicates no such script activity was logged in the window.

config.content: SELECT process_name, device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) as connection_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE direction = 'outbound' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_name, device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) <= 3 ORDER BY connection_count DESC
config.description: Find rare processes beaconing to external IPs, characteristic of the interactive reverse shells.
config.expected_signal: A process seen on very few hosts exhibiting persistent outbound network connectivity. Silence means no rare beaconing was observed.
